_doc: Escrow request pins (T-048, A-016 = B). For each official pack, request_sha256 = sha256 of seller/review-prompt.js buildReviewRequest(pack) (UTF-8), the exact body the NEAR AI TEE signs. contract/src/pins.rs must hold the same prompt_version, model and pins (Rust test), and npm test recomputes this file from the packs. `rejected` are near-miss requests for pack-1 the contract must refuse. Regenerate on purpose with: node scripts/freeze-packs.mjs
